To the shield-bearers sent for our safety, 

We were driven off by walking clay, ancient things with no love for pick or torch. The job's forsaken, and we've made for home before we?re sculpted into rubble ourselves. 

Barnabas Duunfire 
628 Mining and Foraging Guild
